title: Ball — Graphic Constancy Across Sources
subtitle: Twelve round anchors across clocks, wheels, vessels, optics, and play
lineage: Lineage: Daniel Mercadante, Ball (Bach performed by Grigory Sokolov)
theorem: Hold one graphic anchor perceptually steady while its material, scale, and social purpose change across images. Release the crop on an irregular rim so its human use becomes legible.
boundary_note: Conservative shot durations (2.8–4.5s) allow each material to be seen without high-frequency flash overload. Off-center circular targets are registered to (640, 352) via anchor_xy translation.

v1_defect_timecodes: Seg #03 (t=07.00s-10.50s): In `adfad259`, the wall clock is off-center to the upper-left while the registration ring sits at screen center.
Seg #09 (t=27.70s-31.20s): `5a73aa82` at in_s=0.5s shows foliage/flowers before the circular optical aperture appears at 18.5s.
Seg #10 & #11 (t=31.20s-38.10s): Internal source cuts inside `3681afce` and `10812563`.
critic_tribunal.largest_gap: Graphic constancy breaks in Seg #09 (foliage instead of optical aperture) and Seg #03 (unregistered clock offset), compounded by internal cuts in Seg #10 and #11.
critic_tribunal.causal_hypothesis: Wrong timestamp window on `5a73aa82` (0.5s instead of 18.5s-25.5s), missing `anchor_xy` translation in `build_circle_reg_shot` for `adfad259`, and unclamped windows in `3681afce` and `10812563`.
critic_tribunal.falsifiable_repair: Add `anchor_xy: [0.43, 0.45]` translation in `build_circle_reg_shot` for `adfad259`; set `5a73aa82` to `in_s=19.0, dur=3.5, custom_window=True` where the circular optical aperture is centered; replace Seg #10 with verified circular projector reel `989d1a70` (`0.1s-3.6s`, `anchor_xy=[0.47, 0.35]`) and clamp `10812563` to its cut-free ring-of-hands window (`3.35s-6.20s`).
critic_tribunal.strength_to_preserve: The contextual release in Seg #08 (`8266284b`, `Facts About Film`, 1948) where pulling back from the circular reel reveals the boy's hands, and the final exit in Seg #13 (`c0f8dea4`).
